_note: Shared ad config for every app. The ad tag is Haukley's own VMAP schedule per title (scripts/make_vmap.py -> haukley.com/ads/vmap/<id>.xml): a pre-roll plus one mid-roll at the halfway point for titles 20+ minutes. Until the Google Ad Manager account exists each break returns an empty VAST (no fill), so no ads play; set VAST_TAG in make_vmap.py and rerun to turn ads on everywhere without an app update.
